_about: The campaign page (wehale.io/<route>, today /recharge) (docs/recharge/README.md). Everything that changes before or at launch is here. CONFIDENTIAL until launch: the page is gated (gate), noindex, out of the sitemap, disallowed in robots.txt and linked from nowhere.
_about_route: The page's path, the one place it is set: the page, the sitemap exclusion, the noindex headers (written into dist/_headers at build) and the QR codes all follow it.

gate._about: Obscurity, not security: the page renders only with ?k=<key>, whose salted SHA-256 is compared in the browser; without it the visitor gets the site's 404. The key itself is not in the repo. At launch set on to false (the one flag), and see docs/recharge/README.md for the rest of the launch list.

session._about: STAND-IN: The Wake Up (Edvin) until the campaign session is recorded (Philip). To drop the real one in: put score.json and audio.mp3 in public/recharge/session/, point score and audio there, and set narrator, minutes and start (seconds, about 1 s before the guide's first word). world: the Tide world the session plays in; the Cell visual replaces it once integrated.
session.title: Charge Your Current

partner_logo._about: One swappable file per ground: src on the light screens (black), src_dark in the session (white). The committed files are dashed PLACEHOLDERS. The partner's real logo (marked wip) is never committed: for local previews put it at local / local_dark (gitignored, public/recharge/*.local.*) and the build uses it; ask the lead before adding it to the repo. Sizes: the wordmark's cap height optically matches WeHale's (real logo trimmed, 26 px tall on an 18 px WeHale logo, one baseline).

code._about: The code rides in the OneLink's deep_link_value; the app applies it at sign-up (email, Apple and Google). PLACEHOLDER: the owner of main creates the real codes in the admin; RECHARGE is the campaign default, ?c=<CODE> overrides it (influencers' personal codes).

onelink._about: AppsFlyer OneLink, template zcid (the same as /breathe). pid is a CONFIG CHOICE for the lead and the owner of main: the media source this campaign reports under in AppsFlyer.
